Persist scheduled GitHub authorization schema v3 (#206)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-7
  description: |-
    Scheduled GitHub jobs now persist canonical schema v3 with an explicit account, tagged repository or organization scope, and read/write access.
    
    v1/v2 snapshots stay byte-compatible exact-repository ceilings. Create/update and every attempt intersect the saved ceiling with current owner, route, and live catalog/risk. Organization escape, auto accounts, destructive access, and later privilege growth fail closed. Expanding an exact-repository job to organization scope requires a generation-checked update; deployment does not rewrite old jobs.
    
    No migration is added. Scheduler diagnostics expose secret-free schema, digest, account, scope, and access.
